## Mode
greenfield

## Problem Statement
Please add a /version endpoint to the api_test service. It should return JSON with three fields: the application version string, the git commit the running build was made from, and the service name. Read-only, no auth, no database — the same shape as the existing /uptime and /stats endpoints. Success: GET /version returns 200 with all three fields populated, and any write method on /version (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) returns 405.
